_comment: TEST ONLY — NOT A SECRET, NEVER USED IN PRODUCTION. Ed25519 keypair used to mint/verify licenses in dev + tests for the E7 entitlement pipeline. The real production signing key is generated by the (not-yet-built) cloud signing service and must NEVER be committed or baked into the binary. The verifying key here is the debug-only fallback for `verify_license`; release builds require LICENSE_PUBLIC_KEY to be baked in via build.rs and treat an absent key as Invalid.
